clermontcathedral.name: Clermont Cathedral
clermontcathedral.slogan: A cathedral cut from the black lava of the volcanoes next door.
clermontcathedral.line: Built of dark Volvic lava stone, its west facade and twin spires were only completed in 1884, designed in Viollet-le-Duc's circle.

panoramiquedesdomes.name: Puy de Dome
panoramiquedesdomes.slogan: Ride a cog train to the summit of the Chaine des Puys.
panoramiquedesdomes.line: At 1,465 metres, the Puy de Dome has been reachable by the Panoramique des Domes rack railway since May 2012.

ndportclermont.name: Notre-Dame-du-Port
ndportclermont.slogan: Auvergne Romanesque at its calmest, with pilgrims' footsteps worn in.
ndportclermont.line: This 12th-century basilica joined the UNESCO list on 2 December 1998 as part of the Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France.

vulcaniapark.name: Vulcania
vulcaniapark.slogan: Walk down inside a volcano without the lava.
vulcaniapark.line: Designed by Austrian architect Hans Hollein with Atelier 4 and opened in 2002, much of Vulcania is buried underground like a mound.

michelinadventure.name: L'Aventure Michelin
michelinadventure.slogan: Bibendum's home town, tyre by tyre and star by star.
michelinadventure.line: The Michelin company museum opened beside the Clermont-Ferrand factory on 23 January 2009 and has passed one million visitors.
